units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|log|1062|0
units.english: Heard about some tiny creatures called "Delvan shipworms" which can eat through a ship's hull. Apparently infestations are getting more frequent.
units.italian: Ho sentito parlare di piccole creature chiamate "teredini di Delve" che riescono a mangiare lo scafo di una nave. A quanto pare le infestazioni stanno diventando più frequenti.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|The mountain air tastes cool and fresh after breathing the constantly recycled air on the <ship> for so long, so you take a moment to get a good lungful and enjoy the view. Just off to your right, ground technicians wearing thin coveralls and breathing gear are spraying some kind of chemical on the hull of a parked Sunder. The fine mist reflects a bright rainbow which contrasts strikingly with the dull gray metal of the hull.|1064|0
units.english: The mountain air tastes cool and fresh after breathing the constantly recycled air on the <ship> for so long, so you take a moment to get a good lungful and enjoy the view. Just off to your right, ground technicians wearing thin coveralls and breathing gear are spraying some kind of chemical on the hull of a parked Sunder. The fine mist reflects a bright rainbow which contrasts strikingly with the dull gray metal of the hull.
units.italian: L'aria di montagna sa di fresco dopo aver respirato a lungo l'aria sempre riciclata della <ship>, così ti prendi un momento per fare un bel respiro pieno e goderti la vista. Poco alla tua destra, tecnici di terra in tuta sottile e maschere respiratorie stanno spruzzando una specie di sostanza chimica sullo scafo di un Sunder parcheggiato. La nebbiolina sottile riflette un arcobaleno vivido che contrasta in modo sorprendente con il grigio opaco del metallo dello scafo.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	You wander over, careful not to get too close to the spray, which you assume is toxic. One of the technicians climbs down a ladder attached to the hull as you approach, then turns to you, pulling his mask off to reveal a dark-skinned man in his early twenties, his hair plastered to his forehead by copious amounts of sweat.|1065|0
units.english: You wander over, careful not to get too close to the spray, which you assume is toxic. One of the technicians climbs down a ladder attached to the hull as you approach, then turns to you, pulling his mask off to reveal a dark-skinned man in his early twenties, his hair plastered to his forehead by copious amounts of sweat.
units.italian: Ti avvicini, attento a non finire troppo vicino allo spruzzo, che supponi tossico. Uno dei tecnici scende da una scala appoggiata allo scafo mentre ti avvicini, poi si volta verso di te e si toglie la maschera, rivelando un uomo dalla pelle scura sulla ventina, con i capelli incollati alla fronte da copiose quantità di sudore.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"This your ship?" he asks with a professionally neutral expression.|1066|0
units.english: "This your ship?" he asks with a professionally neutral expression.
units.italian: "È la tua nave?", chiede con un'espressione professionalmente neutra.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"No, I'm just curious. What are you doing to it?"|1068|0
units.english: "No, I'm just curious. What are you doing to it?"
units.italian: "No, sono solo curioso. Cosa ci stai facendo?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"Yes. How is the work coming along?"|1070|0
units.english: "Yes. How is the work coming along?"
units.italian: "Sì. Come procede il lavoro?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	The technician shakes his head morosely.|1071|0
units.english: The technician shakes his head morosely.
units.italian: Il tecnico scuote la testa con aria mesta.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"It's confirmed. Shipworm. Bad case, too - I'm surprised your hull was still holding atmosphere." He looks back at the Sunder, measuring it up with his eyes. "We should be finished with the decontamination in a couple hours, but then we'll need to go over her with sealant. Probably two coats. We'll be finished tomorrow afternoon, earliest."|1072|0
units.english: "It's confirmed. Shipworm. Bad case, too - I'm surprised your hull was still holding atmosphere." He looks back at the Sunder, measuring it up with his eyes. "We should be finished with the decontamination in a couple hours, but then we'll need to go over her with sealant. Probably two coats. We'll be finished tomorrow afternoon, earliest."
units.italian: "È confermato. Teredine. Caso brutto, anche: mi sorprende che il tuo scafo tenesse ancora l'atmosfera." Guarda di nuovo il Sunder, misurandolo con gli occhi. "Dovremmo finire la decontaminazione in un paio d'ore, ma poi dovremo passarla tutta con il sigillante. Probabilmente due mani. Finiremo domani pomeriggio, al più presto."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"Shipworm? Never heard of it."|1074|0
units.english: "Shipworm? Never heard of it."
units.italian: "Teredine? Mai sentite."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"Oh. Okay, carry on."|1076|0
units.english: "Oh. Okay, carry on."
units.italian: "Oh. Va bene, continua."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	He looks you up and down, perhaps wondering if he will get in trouble for telling you about another captain's ship, but then he shrugs and opens up.|1079|0
units.english: He looks you up and down, perhaps wondering if he will get in trouble for telling you about another captain's ship, but then he shrugs and opens up.
units.italian: Ti guarda da capo a piedi, forse chiedendosi se si metterà nei guai a parlarti della nave di un altro capitano, poi alza le spalle e si apre.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"Shipworm infestation. Third one this week." He pushes his hood back and runs his hand through his greasy hair. "Honestly, I'm surprised the media hasn't been covering it yet. Maybe they're waiting for the first spontaneous depressurization so they have something really juicy to talk about."|1080|0
units.english: "Shipworm infestation. Third one this week." He pushes his hood back and runs his hand through his greasy hair. "Honestly, I'm surprised the media hasn't been covering it yet. Maybe they're waiting for the first spontaneous depressurization so they have something really juicy to talk about."
units.italian: "Infestazione di teredine. La terza questa settimana." Si tira indietro il cappuccio e si passa la mano tra i capelli unti. "Sinceramente mi sorprende che i media non ne abbiano ancora parlato. Forse aspettano la prima depressurizzazione spontanea per avere qualcosa di davvero succoso di cui parlare."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"Shipworm? What is that?"|1082|0
units.english: "Shipworm? What is that?"
units.italian: "Teredine? Cosa sono?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"You think it's a cover-up?"|1083|0
units.english: "You think it's a cover-up?"
units.italian: "Credi che sia un insabbiamento?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"They're tiny little creatures, about the size of a pinhead, and they get everywhere if you're not careful. They feed on a whole load of different metals, it has the science geeks blowing their tops. So far they haven't found an alloy that these guys can't digest."|1086|0
units.english: "They're tiny little creatures, about the size of a pinhead, and they get everywhere if you're not careful. They feed on a whole load of different metals, it has the science geeks blowing their tops. So far they haven't found an alloy that these guys can't digest."
units.italian: "Sono piccole creature, grandi più o meno come una capocchia di spillo, e finiscono dappertutto se non stai attento. Si nutrono di un mucchio di metalli diversi, la cosa fa saltare la testa ai cervelloni della scienza. Finora non hanno trovato una lega che questi cosini non riescano a digerire."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	"As a model Syndicate employee," he says sardonically, "I can tell you that the rumors that the shipworm is indigenous to this planet are untrue, and that the miners are categorically not hauling them out of the ground along with the ore. In fact, if you even use the term 'Delvan shipworm' there is a good chance that you'll have Syndicate lawyers suing you for defamation."|1088|0
units.english: "As a model Syndicate employee," he says sardonically, "I can tell you that the rumors that the shipworm is indigenous to this planet are untrue, and that the miners are categorically not hauling them out of the ground along with the ore. In fact, if you even use the term 'Delvan shipworm' there is a good chance that you'll have Syndicate lawyers suing you for defamation."
units.italian: "Come modello di dipendente del Sindacato", dice sardonicamente, "posso dirti che le voci secondo cui le teredine sono autoctone di questo pianeta sono false, e che i minatori non le tirano assolutamente fuori dal terreno insieme al minerale. Anzi, se usi anche solo l'espressione 'teredine di Delve' ci sono buone probabilità che gli avvocati del Sindacato ti facciano causa per diffamazione."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Delve|	You thank the technician for his time and turn back toward the <ship>, wondering if maybe you should park it a bit further away.|1089|0
units.english: You thank the technician for his time and turn back toward the <ship>, wondering if maybe you should park it a bit further away.
units.italian: Ringrazi il tecnico per la disponibilità e torni verso la <ship>, chiedendoti se non sia il caso di parcheggiarla un po' più lontano.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|A loud commotion draws your attention as you make your way through the spaceport and you look up to see three large Lovelace Labs security guards surrounding an irate pilot.|1101|0
units.english: A loud commotion draws your attention as you make your way through the spaceport and you look up to see three large Lovelace Labs security guards surrounding an irate pilot.
units.italian: Un trambusto rumoroso attira la tua attenzione mentre attraversi lo spazioporto e alzi lo sguardo: tre grossi agenti di sicurezza dei Lovelace Labs stanno circondando un pilota furibondo.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"But I've got to unload my cargo!" the pilot is shouting right into the face of a guard who looks completely unfazed.|1102|0
units.english: "But I've got to unload my cargo!" the pilot is shouting right into the face of a guard who looks completely unfazed.
units.italian: "Ma devo scaricare il mio carico!", sta urlando il pilota proprio in faccia a un agente che sembra del tutto imperturbabile.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"Not here you've not," she says in a bored manner, as though she deals with this kind of situation twenty times a day. "Not until you get your ship decontaminated."|1103|0
units.english: "Not here you've not," she says in a bored manner, as though she deals with this kind of situation twenty times a day. "Not until you get your ship decontaminated."
units.italian: "Non qui, no", dice lei con aria annoiata, come se affrontasse questo genere di situazione venti volte al giorno. "Non prima che la tua nave sia decontaminata."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	You are now just one of a whole crowd of onlookers surrounding the group in a big circle. The pilot seems to notice that he is the center of attention and decides to appeal to the crowd.|1104|0
units.english: You are now just one of a whole crowd of onlookers surrounding the group in a big circle. The pilot seems to notice that he is the center of attention and decides to appeal to the crowd.
units.italian: Ora sei solo uno di una folla di curiosi che circonda il gruppo in un grande cerchio. Il pilota sembra accorgersi di essere al centro dell'attenzione e decide di appellarsi alla folla.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"You see what they're doing?" he yells. "This is... this is overreach! I'm being harassed!"|1105|0
units.english: "You see what they're doing?" he yells. "This is... this is overreach! I'm being harassed!"
units.italian: "Vedete cosa stanno facendo?", urla. "Questo è... questo è un abuso! Sono vittima di molestie!"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	The guard is unimpressed, poking at a datapad as she talks.|1106|0
units.english: The guard is unimpressed, poking at a datapad as she talks.
units.italian: L'agente non si scompone, e picchietta su un datapad mentre parla.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"Rules are rules and you gotta follow them just like everyone else." She looks up, eyes narrowed. "It says here your cargo is miniature figurines. What exactly are they made out of?"|1107|0
units.english: "Rules are rules and you gotta follow them just like everyone else." She looks up, eyes narrowed. "It says here your cargo is miniature figurines. What exactly are they made out of?"
units.italian: "Le regole sono regole e devi seguirle come tutti gli altri." Alza lo sguardo, gli occhi socchiusi. "Qui dice che il tuo carico è fatto di statuine in miniatura. E di cosa sono fatte, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	The pilot looks suddenly sheepish, throwing his hands up in defeat.|1108|0
units.english: The pilot looks suddenly sheepish, throwing his hands up in defeat.
units.italian: Il pilota sembra improvvisamente mortificato e alza le mani in segno di resa.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"Alright, alright," he says. "I'll get the decon procedure done. Okay? You win."|1109|0
units.english: "Alright, alright," he says. "I'll get the decon procedure done. Okay? You win."
units.italian: "Va bene, va bene", dice. "Farò la procedura di decon. Ok? Hai vinto."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"What. Are. They. Made of?"|1110|0
units.english: "What. Are. They. Made of?"
units.italian: "Di. Cosa. Sono. Fatte?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"Stainless steel."|1111|0
units.english: "Stainless steel."
units.italian: "Acciaio inossidabile."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"Ouch," she says, but the bored expression is gone now and she seems to be enjoying herself. "Twelve tons of miniature figurines, and we are gonna have to scan every single one to make sure they're not contaminated. That could take a while."|1112|0
units.english: "Ouch," she says, but the bored expression is gone now and she seems to be enjoying herself. "Twelve tons of miniature figurines, and we are gonna have to scan every single one to make sure they're not contaminated. That could take a while."
units.italian: "Ahia", dice lei, ma l'espressione annoiata è sparita e sembra divertirsi. "Dodici tonnellate di statuine e dovremo scansionarle tutte, una per una, per assicurarci che non siano contaminate. Potrebbe volerci un po'."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	With a scattering of chuckles and a few sympathetic groans the crowd starts to disperse, and the two other guards lead the pilot back towards his ship, leaving the main guard tapping happily at her datapad. After a few moments she looks up, noticing you watching her.|1113|0
units.english: With a scattering of chuckles and a few sympathetic groans the crowd starts to disperse, and the two other guards lead the pilot back towards his ship, leaving the main guard tapping happily at her datapad. After a few moments she looks up, noticing you watching her.
units.italian: Tra qualche risatina sparsa e qualche gemito di compassione la folla comincia a disperdersi, e gli altri due agenti riportano il pilota verso la sua nave, lasciando l'agente principale a picchiettare allegramente sul datapad. Dopo qualche istante alza lo sguardo e nota che la stai guardando.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"Delvan shipworms?"|1115|0
units.english: "Delvan shipworms?"
units.italian: "Teredini di Delve?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"That seemed a bit harsh."|1117|0
units.english: "That seemed a bit harsh."
units.italian: "Mi è sembrato un po' duro."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"That was fun."|1118|0
units.english: "That was fun."
units.italian: "È stato divertente."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	She shrugs. "Just doing my job."|1119|0
units.english: She shrugs. "Just doing my job."
units.italian: Alza le spalle. "Faccio solo il mio lavoro."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Ada|	"Uh-huh," she says. "Only we're now seeing them on ships that haven't been near Delve. They seem to be spreading."|1122|0
units.english: "Uh-huh," she says. "Only we're now seeing them on ships that haven't been near Delve. They seem to be spreading."
units.italian: "Uh-huh", dice. "Solo che ora le vediamo su navi che non sono state da nessuna parte vicino a Delve. Sembra che si stiano diffondendo."
